summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam kit by Pissei, launched 12 December 2025. 'UAE / Emirates / XRG' fills the chest and the back (Emirates is the title sponsor, XRG co-title since 2025). FAB and e& are on the chest, e& also on the collar and the upper back, Analog across the shoulders, Richard Mille along the collar, FAB above ADQ on the sleeves, MyWhoosh on the back shoulders, G42 and the Colnago clover on the shorts, IHC on the seat of the shorts. Marked complete: the team's launch photos and the front and back views in the launch article's media pack show no other sponsor. 'UAE' is the country's name in the team name, the UCI 'WorldTour Best Team 2025' badge is an award and '#WeAreUAE' is a slogan; none has a sponsor record.
